info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Unit Financial Analysis Reviews API
info.description: The Business Unit Financial Analysis Reviews API facilitates the submission and management of performance reviews related to specific business units within an organization. This endpoint allows users to upload reviews for financial assessments, ensuring insights are captured efficiently. Typically used by finance professionals and business analysts, this API supports the ongoing evaluation of financial health and strategic decision-making. By integrating feedback into performance reviews, organizations can drive accountability and enhance financial performance monitoring.

post.summary: Create a review for a specific financial analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new review for the financial analysis of a specific business unit identified by RES-100045. The review will be associated with the business unit's financial performance, enabling feedback and assessment.
